name: topopt
description: Describe a part in words. Claude builds the problem, runs a topology optimization on your computer, and gives you a printable STL. Skills, a local MCP server and five role sub-agents. The first start sets up Python for 1 to 3 minutes. Meanwhile topopt connects at once with all its tools, and a tool call answers with the setup status. After the setup the tools work in the same session.
